items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Pete Bocci was just playing violin. So, we started.

ctx.x: Were you playing violin with the Spanish yourself?

For me? No, I was piano. Pete Bocci was just playing violin. So, we started. On our first number that time, he said, well, right there, get that kicker down there. Well, I just want to acknowledge him that Silister had an experience. Well, he did out pretty nice, but he's nervous. Been along pretty good. Then, the second tune we played, The Flowers Blown in Springtime. Well, he could shine on that. Jack used to play it all the time. Everybody liked it. The girls came by the stairs. Sounds nice, nice, fine.…
How did you happen to hire Papa Teal?
